summary: The author analysis matches the registered sex-adjusted age contrast in the same eight animals. All 85 source files matched their manifest entries, and all nine computations reproduced. All three hypothalamus genes in Supplementary Data 2 agreed in direction, with a maximum absolute difference of 0.02769 log2 units. I narrowed the coverage claim to that table and corrected the source status because the fresh GEO metadata differs from its historical checksum.
openIssues: The reviewed sources did not yield the complete hypothalamus age-effect table or per-gene author FDR values. Three paired genes fall below the 30-pair concordance minimum.
